title: Ocho Cinco Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutOcho Cinco ~ 85 San Juan Avenue ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Ocho Cinco is a beautiful home just 528 feet from the San Juan Beach Access. With 5 bedrooms and 4.5 baths, Ocho Cinco will sleep up to 12 guests and offers 3,612sf of indoor and outdoor porch living (2,876 interior sf). Private heated 10x20 pool (saltwater - heating fee applies). Designed for multi-families with room to spread out, Ocho Cinco is an amazing vacation home you need to experience! Easy walk to beach, quiet neighborhood street, fenced yard, modern design...still feels and looks brand new! After a day of playing on the beach, or lounging poolside, why not utilize your Beach Gear credit to rent a bike and enjoy a leisurely, 1.5-mile ride along the Timpoochee Trail into Seaside. Here enjoy the delectable delights along Air Stream Row, sunset cocktails overlooking the beach at Bud and Alleys, a free concert or movie at the Amphitheater, exploring the neighborhood architecture, and shopping for local sundries in one of the quaint boutiques and art galleries along the Town Center and Ruskin Place. Ground Floor: 1 bedroom. 1 full bath. Powder room. Laundry room. Fully equipped kitchen. Living room. Dining table seats 8. Bar seating for 4. Covered porch. #1 En-suite bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower (large closet will fit pack-n-play) 2nd Floor: Kids den. 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, covered porches. #2 Bedroom has 1 Full-Over-Full bunk (sleeping 2 ONLY)), floor space for pack-n-play #3 Bedroom has 2 Bunks (4 Twins ONLY are available for use) Full Shared Bath with tub/shower #4 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, covered porch #5 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, separate soaking tub, private covered porch overlooking pool Amenities: Business Features Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 5 Flat Screen Smart TVs, 1 Blu-Ray/DVD player, board games, books Distinctive Features Private heated pool (saltwater - heating fee applies) 528' from neighborhood beach access with parking, shower, foot wash 2 living rooms Bed, bath, kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Driveway parking for 4 vehicles 3 King beds, 2 Twin Bunks (4 Twins ONLY available for use), 1 Full-Over-Full Bunk (sleeping 2 ONLY) - sleeps maximum 12 guests. 4 full bathrooms, 1 powder room, pack-n-play, baby gate, iron, ironing board, 4 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor shower, outdoor porches, porch furniture. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen with stainless KitchenAid appliances, coffee maker, gas range, double oven, French door refrigerator with ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, pantry, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Grayton Beach (4 miles)Seaside (1.5 mile)WaterColor (2 miles)
